title: Fraction-field derivation detecting a non-pth-power
statement: ∃ D : Derivation ℤ M M, D (algebraMap B M f) ≠ 0

proof.text: Transfer characteristic p to M by fraction-field injectivity. Over the perfect prime field ZMod p, the differential of f is nonzero by the pth-power criterion. Mathlib Module.Projective.exists_dual_ne_zero gives a linear form nonzero on that differential; composing it with the universal derivation and restricting scalars to Z gives the required absolute derivation.

proof_origin.place: Tag 07PH, differential-functional argument directly via Mathlib dual separation and the universal differential

lean.statement:
theorem exists_fraction_field_derivation_of_not_pth_power
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [CharP B p]
    (M : Type v) [Field M] [Algebra B M] [IsFractionRing B M]
    (R₀ : Type w) [CommRing R₀] [IsNoetherianRing R₀] [IsLocalRing R₀]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R₀) R₀]
    [Algebra R₀ B] [Algebra.FiniteType R₀ B]
    (f : B) (hf : ¬ ∃ x : M, x ^ p = algebraMap B M f) :
    ∃ D : Derivation ℤ M M, D (algebraMap B M f) ≠ 0
